projects.name: Roger – AI Character on the Simoco VR950
projects.shortIntro: An interactive AI character running on the Linux-based Simoco VR950 edge computer at Comms Connect, Melbourne. Roger greets visitors, controls GPIOs, talks to CAN bus and sends SMS to visitors' phones.
projects.intro: To showcase the Simoco VR950 at Comms Connect (Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre), I built Roger, an interactive AI character for our exhibition stand. The VR950 is a full-scale, Linux-driven edge computer, not just a router, and Roger runs directly on it using its integrated cameras, microphones and speakers. Roger greets attendees, introduces our latest product breakthroughs and loops in sales representatives. Powered by the Gemini live model and deeply integrated with the unit's onboard Linux environment, Roger doesn't just talk: it controls physical hardware via GPIOs, interfaces with vehicle systems over CAN bus, and triggers SMS text messages to a visitor's phone.
